items.name: scikit-learn
items.non_blocking_finding: scikit-learn is not declared in pyproject.toml. The license is permissive, so this is a reproducibility and supply-chain hygiene issue rather than a legal block.

research_only_nc_statement.question: Is anything in the list research-only, non-commercial, or CC-BY-NC?
research_only_nc_statement.answer: Yes. Two distinct problems, which are not the same kind of problem.

no_license_granted_at_all.note: Legally more restrictive than NC in practice: no rights are granted. The Zenodo dataset's CC BY 4.0 grant does not reach this separate code repository.

research_only_nc_statement.permissive_remainder: All other entries (Zenodo benchmark data, TreeLearn code and weights, OpenPoints, PointNeXt, SoftGroup, Point-SAM code and weights, Pointcept code, Point Transformer V3 code and checkpoint, Point-M2AE, PyTorch, NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn) are under CC-BY-4.0, MIT, Apache-2.0 or BSD-3-Clause, which permit commercial use and redistribution subject to attribution and notice retention.

blocking_findings.what: The repository publishes no license of any kind.
blocking_findings.why_it_blocks: With no grant there is no permission to copy, modify, or redistribute the code - or a derivative translation of its evaluation logic - in a commercial product. An unlicensed component is not a clean component.
blocking_findings.current_exposure: None. REFERENCED_ONLY; the round cites the evaluator's coordinate convention with a pinned commit SHA and explicitly notes that no implementation was copied.
blocking_findings.trigger: Copying any part of base_evaluation.py or its sibling evaluators into research/tree_qc_v2/ or product code; vendoring the repo; or shipping a rewrite that is a line-by-line translation of it.
blocking_findings.required_action: Keep reference-only and implement the metric independently from the paper's definition; or obtain written permission from Q-ForestLab; or re-audit if the repository later gains a permissive license.

blocking_findings.what: Publisher states the weights are CC-BY-NC-4.0 while the code is Apache-2.0.
blocking_findings.why_it_blocks: CC BY-NC 4.0 excludes commercial use. Shipping Sonata weights, or a model fine-tuned from them, inside a commercially deployed TreeLineWarning is outside the grant.
blocking_findings.trap: The Pointcept/Sonata Hugging Face mirror is tagged license:mit and the official facebook/sonata card carries no license tag. Neither overrides Meta's stated NC term.
blocking_findings.required_action: If Sonata is adopted, use the code only (Apache-2.0) and train from scratch, or license the weights from Meta. Do not ship the published checkpoint.

blocking_findings.what: The official code release could not be located, so its license is UNVERIFIED.
blocking_findings.why_it_blocks: An unverifiable license cannot be cleared. 'Probably MIT' is not a clearance.
blocking_findings.current_exposure: None. NOT_USED; referenced by name only in a policy document.
blocking_findings.required_action: If V1 architecture is required, use the MIT-licensed Pointcept implementation at pointcept/models/point_transformer/, which is verifiable and permissive.

blocking_findings.component: Per-checkpoint NC licensing inside permissive codebases
blocking_findings.what: Pointcept code is MIT, but its checkpoints are licensed individually: Pointcept/PointTransformerV3 is MIT while Pointcept/Concerto and Pointcept/Utonia are cc-by-nc-4.0.
blocking_findings.why_it_blocks: A permissive code license does not launder a NonCommercial weights license. Adopting 'a Pointcept checkpoint' is not one decision, it is a decision per checkpoint.
blocking_findings.required_action: Add a checkpoint-level license gate to any future model-adoption checklist. Never infer a checkpoint's license from its repository LICENSE file.

blocking_findings.component: Weights and artifacts carrying licenses different from their code
blocking_findings.what: The pattern occurs at least four times in this list: Sonata (code Apache-2.0 / weights CC-BY-NC-4.0), Point-SAM (code MIT / weights Apache-2.0), Pointcept (code MIT / weights per-checkpoint, some NC), TreeLearn (code MIT in git / weights CC BY 4.0 on a separate Dataverse host).
blocking_findings.why_it_matters: A reviewer who clears 'the repo' has not cleared 'the model'. This is the single most likely way a future round ships a restricted artifact by accident.
blocking_findings.required_action: For every adopted component, record the code license and the weights license as two separate rows with their own URLs.

non_blocking_observations.observation: scikit-learn is imported by research/tree_qc_v2/repr_check.py but is not declared in pyproject.toml.
non_blocking_observations.impact: Reproducibility and supply-chain hygiene only. BSD-3-Clause raises no commercial concern.
non_blocking_observations.action: Declare it, or move the check behind an optional extra.

non_blocking_observations.observation: ForAINet_finetuned_weights_all.pt ships in the same CC BY 4.0 Zenodo record as the TreeLearn weights.
non_blocking_observations.impact: ForAINet is outside the 12 audited items and was not audited. Its own upstream license must be audited separately if it is ever adopted; the record's CC BY 4.0 declaration should not be assumed to resolve a third-party model's terms.

non_blocking_observations.observation: spconv (a TreeLearn code dependency) and open3d / python-fire (TreeInstSegEval's stated main requirements) were not audited.
non_blocking_observations.impact: Only relevant if TreeLearn or the TreeInstSegEval code is ever adopted.

non_blocking_observations.observation: The Tree QC V2 round is clean on all blocking findings as of this audit date.
non_blocking_observations.impact: Every NC or unlicensed item is currently NOT_USED or REFERENCED_ONLY. The blockers above are prospective and exist so that a later adoption decision does not silently cross them.

point_transformer_v1.item: Point Transformer V1 official code release and its license
point_transformer_v1.conclusion: The official code release is not retrievable from GitHub or from the Wayback Machine, so its license cannot be verified. UNVERIFIED is recorded rather than a guess. The verifiable, permissive substitute is the Point Transformer implementation inside Pointcept (MIT).
